################################################################################
Purpose of script: To plot descriptive statistics of per pathogen data 
################################################################################

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("00_pck.R")
library(DataExplorer)
library(naniar)
library(maps)

source("00_fun_descriptive/fun_des_design_pl.R")
source("00_fun_descriptive/fun_des_participants_pl.R")
source("00_fun_descriptive/fun_des_vaccine_pl.R")
source("00_fun_descriptive/fun_des_vaccinesch_pl.R")
source("00_fun_descriptive/fun_des_immunogenicity_pl.R")
source("00_fun_descriptive/fun_des_map_pl.R")

dirs$figures <- glue("outputs/figures") 

theme_set(theme_classic())

# Make a list of pathogens with vaccines
pat_l <- c("rota", "varicella", "measles", "mumps", "rubella", "hav", "men", "pn", "polio", "hib",
           "dipht", "tetan", "pertu", "hbv")
```

# Figures for all 
```{r}
for (i in pat_l) {

  pathogen <- i
  cut_off <- list(
    rota = 20,   
    varicella = 4,
    measles = 150,
    mumps = 231,
    rubella = 4,
    hav = 15,
    men = 0.3,
    pn = 0.05,
    hib = 0.15,
    polio = 8,
    dipht = 8,
    tetan = 0.1,
    pertu = 5,
    hbv = 10)[[pathogen]]
  
  dirs$outputs <- glue("outputs/perpathogen/{pathogen}") 
  
  # Read in data
  dat_l <- list()
  dat_l$vl <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/data_brms_{pathogen}_vl_all.rds"))
  dat_l$vl_s08 <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/data_brms_{pathogen}_vl_s08.rds"))
  
  if(!(pathogen %in% c("polio", "dipht", "tetan", "pertu", "hbv"))) {
    dat_l$v1 <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/data_brms_{pathogen}_v1_all.rds"))
    dat_l$v1_s08 <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/data_brms_{pathogen}_v1_s08.rds"))
  }
  
  # Descriptive plots 
  l_des_design <- sapply(names(dat_l), function(x) {
    fun_des_design_pl(dat = dat_l[[x]], pathogen = pathogen, data_name = x)}, simplify = F)
  
  l_des_participants <- sapply(names(dat_l), function(x) {
    fun_des_participants_pl(dat = dat_l[[x]], pathogen = pathogen, data_name = x)}, simplify = F)
  
  l_des_vaccine <- sapply(names(dat_l), function(x) {
    fun_des_vaccine_pl(dat = dat_l[[x]], pathogen = pathogen, data_name = x)}, simplify = F)
  
  l_des_vaccinesch <- sapply(names(dat_l), function(x) {
    fun_des_vaccinesch_pl(dat = dat_l[[x]], pathogen = pathogen, data_name = x)}, simplify = F)
  
  l_des_immunogenicity <- sapply(names(dat_l), function(x) {
    fun_des_immunogenicity_pl(dat = dat_l[[x]], cutoff = cut_off, 
                              pathogen = pathogen, data_name = x)}, simplify = F)
  
  l_des_map <- sapply(names(dat_l), function(x) {
    fun_des_map_pl(dat = dat_l[[x]], pathogen = pathogen, data_name = x)}, simplify = F)
  
}
```

```{r}
source("../00_fun_descriptive/fun_cluster_country_pl.R")

l_des_cluster_country <- list()
l_des_cluster_country$dl_ii <- sapply(c("kgc", "reg"), function(x) {
  fun_cluster_country_pl(cluster_type_name = x,
                         pathogen = pathogen,
                         dat = dat_l$vl,
                         dat_sens = NULL,
                         file_name = "dl_ee")}, simplify = F)

l_des_cluster_country$dl_s08_ii <- sapply(c("kgc", "reg"), function(x) {
  fun_cluster_country_pl(cluster_type_name = x,
                         pathogen = pathogen,
                         dat = dat_l$dl_ii,
                         dat_sens = dat_l$dl_s08_ii,
                         file_name = "dl_s08_ii")}, simplify = F)
```

```{r}
fun_clusters_pl <- function(dat = dat, pathogen = pathogen, file_name = "ee") {
pl_l1 <- lapply(c("clilat_k1_r8", "clilat_k1_r6a", "clilat_k1_r4", "clilat_k1_r3", "clilat_k1_r2b",
                  "clilat_k2_r8", "clilat_k2_r6a", "clilat_k2_r4", "clilat_k2_r3", "clilat_k2_r2b",
                  "clilat_k2_r8", "clilat_k2_r6a", "clilat_k2_r4", "clilat_k2_r3", "clilat_k2_r2b"), 
               function(varclim) {
                  dat %>%
                    select(c(study, country, lat_med, lon_med, all_of(varclim))) %>%
                    group_by(study, country) %>%
                    mutate(tot = n()) %>%
                    distinct() %>%
                    pivot_longer(all_of(varclim)) %>%
                    mutate(stu_cou = glue("{country}_{study}")) %>%
                    ggplot(aes(y = reorder(stu_cou, lat_med), x = name, fill = value)) + 
                    geom_label(aes(label = value), size = 3) +
                    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Spectral") + 
                    theme(legend.position = "none",
                          axis.title = element_blank(),
                          axis.text.y = element_blank())})
pl_l1_all <- (pl_l1[[1]] + theme(axis.text.y = element_text()) | wrap_plots(pl_l1[2:length(pl_l1)], nrow = 1)) + plot_layout(widths = c(1,14))

ggsave(filename = glue("{dirs$outputs}/_figures/{pathogen}_clusters_{file_name}_pl1.pdf"), plot = pl_l1_all,  
       width = 25, height = 10)

pl_l2 <- lapply(c("reg_2b", "reg_3", "reg_4", "reg_6a", "reg_8", "kgc_1", "kgc_2", "kgc_3"), 
               function(varclim) {
                 dat %>%
                    select(c(study, country, lat_med, lon_med, all_of(varclim))) %>%
                    group_by(study, country) %>%
                    mutate(tot = n()) %>%
                    distinct() %>%
                    pivot_longer(all_of(varclim)) %>%
                    mutate(stu_cou = glue("{country}_{study}")) %>%
                    ggplot(aes(y = reorder(stu_cou, lat_med), x = name, fill = value)) + 
                    geom_label(aes(label = value), size = 3) +
                    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Spectral") + 
                    theme(legend.position = "none",
                          axis.title = element_blank(),
                          axis.text.y = element_blank())})
pl_l2_all <- (pl_l2[[1]] + theme(axis.text.y = element_text()) | wrap_plots(pl_l2[2:length(pl_l2)], nrow = 1)) + plot_layout(widths = c(1,7))
ggsave(filename = glue("{dirs$outputs}/_figures/{pathogen}_clusters_{file_name}_pl2.pdf"), plot = pl_l2_all,  
       width = 13, height = 10)

return(list(pl_l1_all, pl_l2_all))
}

l_clusters <- sapply(names(dat_l), function(x) {
  fun_clusters_pl(dat = dat_l[[x]], pathogen = "rotavirus", file_name = x)}, simplify = F)
```


```{r}
names(dat_l$d1_ii)
fun_clusters_pl <- function(dat = dat, pathogen = "rotavirus", file_name = "ee") {
pl_l3 <- lapply(c("prec_stan2", "prec_stan3", "tavg_stan2", "tavg_stan3", "dayl_stan2", "dayl_stan3"), 
               function(varclim) {
                  dat %>%
                    select(c(study, country, lat_med, lon_med, all_of(varclim))) %>%
                    group_by(study, country) %>%
                    mutate(tot = n()) %>%
                    distinct() %>%
                    pivot_longer(all_of(varclim)) %>%
                    mutate(stu_cou = glue("{country}_{study}")) %>%
                    ggplot(aes(y = reorder(stu_cou, lat_med), x = name, fill = value)) + 
                    geom_label(aes(label = value), size = 3) +
                    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Spectral") + 
                    theme(legend.position = "none",
                          axis.title = element_blank(),
                          axis.text.y = element_blank())})
pl_l3_all <- (pl_l3[[1]] + theme(axis.text.y = element_text()) | wrap_plots(pl_l3[2:length(pl_l3)], nrow = 1)) + plot_layout(widths = c(1,length(pl_l3)-1))

ggsave(filename = glue("{dirs$outputs}/_figures/{pathogen}_clusters_{file_name}_pl3.pdf"), plot = pl_l3_all,  
       width = 7, height = 10)

return(pl_l3_all)
}

l_clusters <- sapply(names(dat_l), function(x) {
  fun_clusters_pl(dat = dat_l[[x]], pathogen = "rotavirus", file_name = x)}, simplify = F)
```
